 There was only ever going to be one club called out at the London Palladium. Amanda Langell | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source Ousmane Dembélé accepted the award on behalf of his club. | FRANCK FIFE/AFP/Getty Images For the second consecutive year, reigning French and European champions Paris Saint-Germain took home Men’s Club of the Year at the 2026 Ballon d’Or ceremony. 
--> For the second consecutive year, reigning French and European champions Paris Saint-Germain took home Men’s Club of the Year at the 2026 Ballon d’Or ceremony. 
 The Parisians were one of the few surefire bets of the night after putting together a sensational 2025–26 campaign. Luis Enrique’s men hoisted a staggering five trophies last season, including the most prestigious prize in club soccer. 
--> The Parisians were one of the few surefire bets of the night after putting together a sensational 2025–26 campaign. Luis Enrique’s men hoisted a staggering five trophies last season, including the most prestigious prize in club soccer. 
 PSG became just the second team in the modern era to win back-to-back Champions League titles; they defended their crown against Arsenal at the Puskás Aréna in Budapest, Hungary and walked away with a 4–3 penalty shootout victory. 
--> PSG became just the second team in the modern era to win back-to-back Champions League titles; they defended their crown against Arsenal at the Puskás Aréna in Budapest, Hungary and walked away with a 4–3 penalty shootout victory. 
 By then, Ousmane Dembélé and Co. had already won the UEFA Super Cup, the FIFA Intercontinental Cup, the Trophée des Champions and Ligue 1. None compared to the euphoria, though, of lifting the club’s second-ever Champions League title. 
--> By then, Ousmane Dembélé and Co. had already won the UEFA Super Cup, the FIFA Intercontinental Cup, the Trophée des Champions and Ligue 1. None compared to the euphoria, though, of lifting the club’s second-ever Champions League title. 
 It was no surprise PSG earned a nomination for 2026 Men’s Club of the Year. Arsenal, Bayern Munich, Bodø/Glimt and Flamengo also got the nod, but there was only ever going to be one winner.

 The first iteration of the award was handed out at the 2021 Ballon d’Or ceremony. It is based not just on performances, but also trophies won, memorable moments, overachievements and fair play. 
--> The first iteration of the award was handed out at the 2021 Ballon d’Or ceremony. It is based not just on performances, but also trophies won, memorable moments, overachievements and fair play. 
 Chelsea lifted the inaugural award after they won the Champions League under Thomas Tuchel. Premier League rivals Manchester City snatched the honor the following year, becoming the first and only team to win the award without winning the Champions League. 
--> Chelsea lifted the inaugural award after they won the Champions League under Thomas Tuchel. Premier League rivals Manchester City snatched the honor the following year, becoming the first and only team to win the award without winning the Champions League. 
 The Cityzens made up for it by topping Europe’s premier club competition in 2022–23, completing a historic treble that also included the Premier League title and the FA Cup. 
--> The Cityzens made up for it by topping Europe’s premier club competition in 2022–23, completing a historic treble that also included the Premier League title and the FA Cup. 
 Real Madrid were the next club etched in the record books for winning their record-extending 15th Champions League title, as well as La Liga and the Spanish Super Cup. Except not a single representative from the club was in Paris to collect the award after Los Blancos boycotted the ceremony in solidarity with Vinícius Júnior, who they believed should have beaten Rodri for the Ballon d’Or. 
--> Real Madrid were the next club etched in the record books for winning their record-extending 15th Champions League title, as well as La Liga and the Spanish Super Cup. Except not a single representative from the club was in Paris to collect the award after Los Blancos boycotted the ceremony in solidarity with Vinícius Júnior, who they believed should have beaten Rodri for the Ballon d’Or. 
 There was much less controversy in 2025 when PSG added the prize to their trophy cabinet for winning their first-ever Champions League title, Ligue 1, the Coupe de France and the Trophée des Champions. The club then waltzed back on stage a year later to go back-to-back.

Born and raised in New York City, her first loves were the Yankees, the Rangers and Broadway before Real Madrid took over her life. Had it not been for her brother’s obsession with Cristiano Ronaldo, she would have never lived through so many magical Champions League nights 3,600 miles away from the Bernabéu.
